properties.name: app.pagination.default-page
properties.description: Page number used when a list request omits page (ticket 04, NFR-14).

properties.name: app.pagination.default-size
properties.description: Page size used when a list request omits size; must be within 1..100 (ticket 04, NFR-14).

properties.name: app.score.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the external Score service (ticket 05).

properties.name: app.messaging.confirm-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait for a RabbitMQ publisher confirm before falling back to the outbox (ticket 06).

properties.name: app.outbox.relay-interval
properties.description: How often the outbox relay retries unsent events (ticket 06).

properties.name: app.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of pending outbox rows one relay run sends, one transaction each (ticket 06).
